header: The plan without a list price
subheader: What large buyers get, with a contact button instead of a checkout
lead: Security review, single sign-on, a named contact, custom terms and payment on account. These are agreed in a meeting, not picked from a list.
note: The note says what the first talk costs and how long an offer is valid. Buyers want both answers.

capabilities.title: The price line keeps its size
capabilities.text: An empty price line looks like missing data. “On request” in large type says the price is agreed separately.

capabilities.title: Capabilities sit in an icon grid
capabilities.text: Two to four columns across the full width, each with a title and one sentence.

capabilities.title: The image is optional
capabilities.text: Without one, the pitch runs across the band on its own.

capabilities.title: Both buttons sit below the price
capabilities.text: One to start the conversation, one to read a document first.

image.alternative: A man and a woman talk at a table with a laptop between them.
